name: main
_note: Stage two. As stage one, and the checks must pass before anything merges.
verify — the register verifies and the self-test passes.
enact  — the change has the class of measure it needs, that measure carried,
it named this change if it named one, and the Keeper approved.
bypass_actors is empty. Nobody pushes to main: not the owner, not an
administrator, not the workflows. close and settle open pull requests like
anyone else, and the gate lets theirs through because records are exempt BY
PATH, not because a workflow is trusted. A workflow that tried to change the
Constitution would be refused exactly as a person would.
The escape hatch is Settings -> Rules -> this ruleset -> Enforcement:
Disabled. Only an administrator can reach it, and the audit workflow records
in a public issue anything that lands ungated while it is off.
